meta.name: muapi-cartoon-dance-animation
meta.description: Convert a photo of a person into a Pixar-style 3D cartoon character, then animate it using a reference dance or motion video.

copy.tagline: 将真人照片转为3D卡通角色并随参考视频跳舞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想把照片变成会跳舞的卡通角色
copy.tagline_en: Turn a photo into a 3D cartoon character that dances to a reference video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn a photo into a dancing cartoon character

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 将用户上传的人物照片转换为皮克斯风格的3D卡通形象，然后根据参考舞蹈视频让该角色跳舞，最终输出一段动画视频。
howto.when: 当用户提供一张人物照片并希望将其卡通化并制作成跳舞动画时触发。

say.text: 把我这张照片变成皮克斯风格的卡通角色。
用这段舞蹈视频让我的卡通角色跳同样的舞。
say.note: 在卡通形象生成后使用，触发动画制作。

howto.what_en: Converts a user-uploaded photo into a Pixar-style 3D cartoon character, then animates it using a reference dance video, outputting an animated video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a photo and wants to cartoonify it and animate it with a dance motion.

say_en.text: Turn this photo into a Pixar-style cartoon character.
Make my cartoon character dance like this video.
say_en.note: Used after character approval to trigger animation.
